items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for SearchWoot public beta or full launch; conditional for bounded internal evidence work and ordinary reversible growth that preserves existing consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, age-sensitive, and data-handling boundaries. Exact decision: keep searchwoot.com private, keep Woot permission outreach unsent, and do not expand alerts, monetization, tracking, deployment, or public exposure. Evidence: Woot API documentation confirms access mechanics but not rights to store, derive, cache, display, alert on, or monetize deal data; current Woot terms restrict the proposed commercial/public data use. Compliance is a technical baseline only: 37 pass, 16 fail, and 6 unknown. Analytics is yellow with permission/collector errors; revenue is partial aggregate and cannot support site-level financial claims. Security, accuracy/freshness, attribution, measurement, and owner gates remain incomplete. Human counsel is required before any rights-dependent launch, permission request, affiliate use, advertising use, or material privacy determination.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 tasks closed and 4 remain open. Existing evidence includes official Woot API, terms, support records, repository/configuration artifacts, privacy and cookie-policy artifacts, and draft terms. No task closes because rights, field-level provenance, retention, deletion, correction, access, notification, GA4 settings, vendor coverage, incident procedures, accuracy/freshness, and rollback evidence remain incomplete. Next action: produce and attach one read-only bundle containing the field-level rights matrix, deployed data-flow and retention table, log/vendor/incident inventory, consent and GA4 configuration evidence, accuracy/freshness controls, and rollback evidence.

Data-use review dispositions: Woot API deal and price-history data — blocked; missing current written permission or API agreement, field-level provenance, storage/caching/display/derivative/alert rights, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, trademark, image, price, affiliate, and advertising terms. Smallest next action: complete the internal counsel packet and obtain human-counsel review before any owner-authorized permission request. User alert rules and sync results — evidence_needed; missing data inventory, identifiers, retention, deletion/correction/access workflow, processor terms, notification consent, and unsubscribe behavior. Smallest next action: produce a read-only deployed/repository data-flow and retention table. GA4 analytics — evidence_needed; missing deployed consent and withdrawal behavior, GA4 property/data-sharing settings, retention settings, and jurisdictional treatment. Smallest next action: capture consent and GA4 configuration evidence without enabling tracking. Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data — evidence_needed; missing log-field inventory, retention/access controls, vendor terms or DPA review, incident procedures, and data-subject request handling. Smallest next action: produce a read-only log, vendor, and incident inventory. No item is clear or ready for go-live.

For private or gated properties, retain the concrete decision to keep SearchWoot private. Scaffold candidates remain preview-only and must not publish until legal/compliance, security, owner, analytics or affiliate readiness, measurement, and rollback evidence is complete. Incomplete telemetry alone is not a general fleet launch blocker, but analytics failures must not be treated as zero and aggregate affiliate revenue must remain unattributed.
